title: Your first week as a RideArrivo driver
excerpt: From application to your first trip: what to expect, what to prepare, and how to make a good first impression.
body:
## Before you apply

Have these ready: a clear profile photo, your driver's licence photo (front side, all corners visible), your vehicle details, a WhatsApp number and an emergency contact. The application takes about 10 minutes.

## Day 1 to 2: review

Our team reviews your licence, vehicle and photos. This usually takes a day or two. We email you once you are approved.

## Before your first trip

- Read the [driver orientation](/drivers#orientation).
- Clean the car inside and out and check tyres, lights and fuel.
- Charge your phone and update the driver app.
- Find the Emergency Button in the app so you know where it is.

## On your first trip

Greet by name. Confirm the destination. Drive smoothly. Thank the rider.

## After your first trip

Check your trips and earnings in the app. Note what went well and what to improve. If something went wrong, contact Support early.

## What good looks like

A good first week is not about the number of trips. It is about doing every trip the same careful way: on time, clean, calm and polite. Ratings and rider trust build from the first trip.

## Common mistakes to avoid

- Going online with an untidy car or a low phone battery.
- Taking a trip you are not sure you can reach on time.
- Talking about fares or company decisions with riders.
- Waiting until a problem is big before contacting Support.

## Ready?

[Apply to drive with RideArrivo](https://www.ridearrivo.com/driver.html).
